full_script: Keep quiet, let me talk to you. The most expensive thing in the world is free advice from a broke relative. My mentor warned me that the greatest tragedy of our generation is consulting an uncle who has failed in three businesses to advise you on your new enterprise. He will use four hours to explain why your dream is impossible, yet he has not successfully executed a dream since nineteen ninety-two. If a mechanic cannot repair his own bicycle, why are you handing him the keys to your commercial truck? People do not criticize your ambition because it is flawed; they criticize it because your courage reminds them of their lifetime of cowardice. From the state of consultative breakdown to the state of financial breakthrough. Guard your ears, execute your vision, and let the results conduct the masterclass.
